 State Fayre Festival 2027 line-up and how to get tickets revealed
 16 November 2026, 16:05 | Updated: 16 November 2026, 16:10
 Shania Twain will be performing at State Fayre Festival.
Picture: 
State Fayre Festival
 By Hope Wilson
 Shania Twain, Kacey Musgraves The Chicks have been confirmed to perform at State Fayre Festival 2027, here's how you can get tickets.
 Listen to this article
 Loading audio... 
 State Fayre Festival will be taking place at Hylands Park, Chelmsford, Essex in 2027.
 The first artist announced to be taking part is Shania Twain, best known for hits such as, You're Still the One, Man! I Feel Like a Woman! and That Don't Impress Me Much .
 Shortly after, Kacey Musgraves and The Chicks were added to the line-up, with many more acts expected to perform at the event next year. 
 Listen to Heart on Global Player, the official Heart app 
 Here's how you can get tickets for State Fayre Festival 2027 and see Shania Twain, Kacey Musgraves and The Chicks live.

 State Fayre Festival 2027 tickets
 Tickets for State Fayre Festival can be purchased here .
 State Fayre Festival 2027 line-up
 Shania Twain was the first confirmed artist to perform at State Fayre Festival on Saturday 19th June 2027.
 Next was Kacey Musgraves who will play on Sunday 20th June, and The Chicks who are taking to the stage on Friday 18th June.
